acceptance_criteria: All ten historical target datasets and figures are generated without reading raw/, references/, Zenodo, author code, author arrays, or source-image pixels.
The printed free-exciton density inversion and chemical-equilibrium residual remain below the configured tolerance, with the conserved-total interpretation kept as a separate sensitivity lane.
The zero-coupling limit recovers the Drude hole response and zero neutral drag.
The interaction rate peaks near the independently derived Delta_star and the exciton drag changes sign across it.
The direct three-fluid matrix solution agrees with the dimensionally corrected closed solution; the literal printed form remains an explicit falsification lane.
Every covered target retains its declared paper_exact, paper_subset, reconstructed_model, or proxy_model parameter status.
Every configured parameter point is checkpointed with config and implementation hashes and can be resumed without recomputation.
Radial-grid doubling and cutoff expansion change all declared primary observables by less than two percent.
Analytic-delta and narrow-Gaussian regularizations agree within the declared convergence envelope.
Direct and trion-eliminated collocation agree to floating-point tolerance, proving that the effective g^4 Q terms are retained.
Missing paper discretization metadata remains labelled reconstructed rather than promoted to paper-exact.
